reason: No linux/amd64 SIF was built or hashed in CI. The Spark image in runtime/runtime-lock.json is linux/arm64 (derived_sif_sha256 3dbfccad3355b27d8a09bd4c0c5895d02a43e1b64203960905b810bbb6bccbe3) and is not a substitute. The launcher refuses to submit while derived_sif_sha256 is null. A later commit may record a measured sha256 of an image built outside this CI, with userspace CUDA that this node's 595.x driver can JIT (the host has no nvcc; PTX is loaded with cuModuleLoadData). This lock does not authorize an r740 observation.

apptainer.note: The amd64 package hash is the one already recorded for the Ubuntu package. It is not a hash of an installed r740 prefix, and it is not the arm64 prefix under /scratch/pireus/runtime.
